svg.text: History from buckets: one range, one bucket size
Concept 11 · the API's defaults, without from/to · the longer the range, the bigger the bucket
turned into the summary shape in the browser
is rounded down, and the bucket that is still
raw readings, one row per message (Module 17)
a TimescaleDB hypertable, split per day; raw readings are kept for 90 days (Module 18)
1 hour: the raw readings as they are
24 hours: grouped when asked, time_bucket('15 minutes', ts)
a limit of 1,000 readings or buckets per request: all three ranges are far below it
the summary book on the right is made from this table: every hour is summarized once, so
the 7-day history only reads 169 rows, not tens of thousands of raw readings
filled by the clerk every 30 minutes, last 3 days only;
without it the 7-day chart can have only
2 points, then (after the clerk has run)
only the last 3 days filled in
What one summary point (SummaryPoint) holds, the same for all three ranges:
Temperature, air humidity, soil moisture, and light only: pressure, battery, water tank, and motion aren't in the summary history.
The table and the CSV use the same answer: 7 days = 169 rows → 24 rows per page, newest first (Page 1 of 8).
Download CSV is made in the browser with a comma separator, a decimal point, and a BOM, for Excel with English settings.
